title: Inventory: Yvert et al. 2003 (Nat Genet 35:57-64) supplementary information
intro: Generated by `ingest/inventory.py` from `sources/yvert2003/raw/`: the two supplementary PDFs linked from
https://www.nature.com/articles/ng1222 (static-content.springer.com), downloaded untouched with plain requests
(the Nature page needs a cookie jar). The article page is kept as `sources/yvert2003/article.html`; its body is
paywalled, so only the abstract, citation metadata and supplement captions are available. No PMC copy exists
(E-utilities elink returns only citing articles). The PDFs are extracted to TSVs by
which the ingest reads. Checksums are in `MANIFEST.tsv`.

roles.41588_2003_BFng1222_MOESM1_ESM.pdf: Supplementary Table 1: 593 clusters of genes with correlated expression in the cross (hierarchical clustering, min_corr > 0.725), member ORFs with annotations (91 pages).
roles.41588_2003_BFng1222_MOESM2_ESM.pdf: Supplementary Table 2: the 13 groups of messages linking to loci with widespread transcriptional effects (trans-acting hotspots): method text, a summary table (messages, common function, linkage bin, putative regulator, % recapitulated from Brem et al. 2002) and the member messages of each group (39 pages).

missing: The main text and Methods are paywalled: linkage statistics, thresholds for individual linkages and the full list of linkages are not in the bundle.
No LOD, p-value, effect size or direction for the groups or their member messages.
No interval per group: the summary gives one linkage-bin label per group (e.g. II:560000) although groups merge two to four 20-kb bins.
No genome build statement (2003); positions are consistent with R64 at bin resolution (see OPEN_QUESTIONS).
